contribute.title: Contribute
contribute.description: Eight kinds of bounded remote contribution, the contribution form fields, the GitHub issue forms and a short invitation groups can adapt.
contribute.formIntro: The pack suggests these fields, in this order:
contribute.submit: Submit through the GitHub issue forms
contribute.submitText: The GitHub issue forms are built from these fields, add the details each kind of contribution needs (such as the current and proposed text of a correction) and end with a privacy confirmation. They ask for no personal contact details; a reviewer is named as a role or an organisation. The pack contains no private complainant data and no personal activist contact database; contributions should stay that way.

sources.packSourceText: The pack text and the structured data on this site are generated from the exported Google Doc below by the importer in tools/import-pack.py. Interface labels are maintained in i18n/, and the few pack sentences that exist only in the source document are quoted in the generator and checked against it by the tests.
about.title: About
about.heading: About this site
about.description: Provenance, versions, licences, the AI-assisted notice and how to re-import the pack.
about.provenanceText: The pack was prepared for discussion, correction and possible collaboration. The pack text and the structured data are generated from the exported source document by tools/import-pack.py and are not hand-edited; corrections go to the source document and are re-imported. Interface labels are maintained in i18n/.
about.licenceCodeText: The code in this repository is released under the MIT licence.
about.licenceContentText: The pack text and the data derived from it are released under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International licence (CC BY-SA 4.0).
about.reimportText: Export the Google Doc as Markdown into content/source/, then run the importer and rebuild:
about.accessibilityText: The site is complete static HTML. JavaScript only adds filtering and a copy button; every page works without it, at 320px width, in print and with a screen reader. Colour contrast is at least 4.5:1 in light and dark mode, focus is visible, route badges always show their letter, and no external fonts, scripts or trackers are loaded.
about.accessibilityForm: Report an accessibility problem through the issue forms
about.languagesText: Interface strings live in i18n/. The content of the pack is English in every language build until a reviewed translation exists.
about.correctionsText: Corrections, evidence checks and disagreement are welcome through the GitHub issue forms.
